processing: 17 OSM constituency relations (boundary=political, political_division=constituency). Checked valid, non-overlapping, gap-free and equal to the OSM county relation; coverage-simplified together at 3e-05 degrees and rounded to 6 decimals. The county outline is the union of the constituencies, so the two layers share every border.
limitations: OSM boundaries are community-mapped, not an official survey. Constituencies are the IEBC electoral units used as Nairobi's 17 sub-counties.
